[[Vine Seed]]s are [[bundle]] items (except the one in Magus Stones) that create vine bridges.

==Locations==
*[[Core]]
**[[Druid's Isle]]
*[[Prophecies]]
**[[The Wilds]]
**[[Bloodstone Fen]]
*[[Eye of the North]]
**[[Magus Stones]]

===Maguuma Jungle===
The Vine Seed is acquired from the two conversing [[Centaur]]s in [[The Wilds]] and [[Vine Seed Flower]]s in [[Bloodstone Fen]].

===Magus Stones===
The [[Timberland Guardian]] will [[drop]] a Vine Seed (which is not a bundle and does not appear in [[inventory]] when retrieved) during the quest, [[Lab Space]]. The Vine Seed is used to create the bridge to the [[Oola's Lab]] dungeon. The bridge only needs to be created once, and will remain in Magus Stones unless a party member has Lab Space active. 

===Druid's Isle===
The [[Druid's Isle]] [[guild hall]] contains a Vine Seed in each base. When dropped on the glowing circle outside of a base, the seed will create a vine bridge into the back entrance. Dropping it anywhere else causes foes to be struck with [[Entanglement]], knocking down [[adjacent]] [[foe]]s for four seconds, after which the vines retreat into the seed and the Vine Seed is ready to be picked up again.

==Notes==
* If picked up the message "Drop it to plant the seed" appears in the [[chat window]].
* If this is not dropped on a glowing circle, it will sprout and revert to its seed form, allowing it to be picked up again.
* If dropped next to a [[miniature]] or [[foe]], they will be knocked down and be trapped by vines for a few seconds.
